  • Reportar ao gestor a necessidade de peças, consultando o manual técnico, com a finalidade de reposição de materiais para realizar a manutenção;
  • Observar e praticar as normas de segurança do trabalho.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ensino médio completo;
  • CNH categoria B;
  • Experiencia como eletricista automotivo;
  • Cursos de capacitação na área e/ou correlacionados;
  • Conhecimento em eletromecânica e eletrônica.


Informações adicionais

Convênio Médico;

Convênio Odontológico;

Seguro de Vida;

Vale Transporte;

Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação;

Cartão Farmácia;

WellHub;

Clube de Vantagens;

Programa de Lucros e Resultados.


Seja bem-vindo(a) à Unidas!

Somos uma das maiores empresas no segmento de locação de veículos e terceirização de frotas. Temos uma plataforma de soluções completas , desde veículos leves, pesados, máquinas e equipamentos para você ou sua empresa. Estamos engajados em simplificar a vida de nossos clientes.

title: Senior Portfolio Manager
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America.

We originate more than R$700M per year in B2B credit to Brazilian SMEs through CrediPay , our embedded finance platform. We operate in a segment where traditional financial infrastructure is limited, building proprietary credit intelligence and risk frameworks that do not yet exist in this market.

By combining structured capital markets solutions with real-time credit decisioning, we enable marketplaces and suppliers to offer seamless payment terms to their buyers, while we manage risk, pricing, and capital efficiency behind the scenes.

We are not a traditional lender. We are building the risk engine that powers scalable B2B commerce in Brazil.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

We are looking for a Senior Portfolio Manager to take end-to-end ownership of portfolio performance and Cost of Risk outcomes. This position reports directly to the Head of Risk.

You will steer portfolio mix and concentration risk, continuously improve provisioning and loss forecasting accuracy, and design risk-adjusted pricing frameworks that enable disciplined but ambitious GTM growth. This is a senior individual contributor role with direct commercial impact and close collaboration across GTM, Treasury, and Collections.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in credit risk, portfolio management, or structured lending
  • Advanced SQL required; Python strongly preferred
  • Proven ownership of Cost of Risk (CoR) and portfolio performance
  • Strong understanding of credit cycles, concentration risk, and sector deterioration
  • Hands-on experience with provisioning models (e.g., IFRS9) and expected loss methodologies
  • Experience building risk-adjusted pricing frameworks
  • Strong commercial judgment — able to enable growth while protecting downside risk
  • Experience working closely with collections or recovery teams
  • Clear communicator, able to translate portfolio insights into business steering decisions
  • Experience with structured vehicles (e.g., FIDC) preferred


Responsibilities

  • Own portfolio steering across channels, sectors, ratings, and accounts
  • Monitor large exposures and concentration risk
  • Steer origination mix to balance growth and profitability
  • Deliver Cost of Risk in line or better than budget
  • Own and improve provisioning logic and expected loss methodologies
  • Reduce variance between expected and realised losses
  • Work closely with Collections to incorporate recovery insights into forecasting assumptions
  • Own risk-adjusted pricing logic for new and existing proposals
  • Partner with GTM to structure commercially competitive yet disciplined offers
  • Build scalable pricing and steering tooling to support faster decision-making
  • Align portfolio strategy with treasury constraints and capital efficiency


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

Quer conhecer mais?


Então, confira os detalhes da vaga e candidate-se!


Sobre a posição:

Esta posição terá papel-chave na sustentação e evolução da performance das equipes comerciais, por meio de uma atuação consultiva, orientada por indicadores, gestão de performance e modelos de remuneração.


Procuramos um(a) profissional com visão de negócio, forte capacidade analítica e experiência apoiando áreas comerciais em ambientes orientados a resultados e com energia e disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.

  • Seguro de vida

title: Analista tributário sênior

title: Software Developer
description:
Job Description

The Company:

Hexagon is a global leader in digital reality solutions, combining sensor, software, and autonomous technologies. We are putting data to work to boost efficiency, productivity, quality, and safety across industrial, manufacturing, infrastructure, public sector, and mobility applications.

Our technologies are shaping the production and people-related ecosystems to become increasingly connected and autonomous — ensuring a scalable, sustainable future.

Hexagon (Nasdaq Stockholm: HEXA B) has approximately 21,000 employees in 50 countries and net sales of approximately 4.6bn USD. Learn more at hexagon.com and follow us @HexagonAB.


Purpose of Position:

Hexagon Mining develops fleet management solutions for manned and unmanned operation for open pit mining. The solutions integrate in-vehicle, on prem and cloud components to improve the mining operation productivity and safety. Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent

  • Experience with Git and agile development processes (e.g. Scrum, SAFe).
  • Full professional English proficiency.

  • Willing to travel to company’s offices and customer visits overseas occasionally.


Desirable:

  • Experience with Python.

  • Experience with continuous integration and test automation.
  • Background on game development


Benefits:

  • Health plan

  • Wellhub (Gym)
  • Life insurance
  • Meal/food allowance
  • Dental plan
  • Private pension plan


Travel Requirements:

5-10% of the time


You will work on products that could revolutionize the mining industry in the next 5 years. Your colleagues consist of highly qualified and open-minded engineers from all over the world. Beside the developer career you will have the opportunity to develop into multiple directions like project management, product management, customer support and sales.

Join our team as a software developer and make a significant impact on our clients' digital transformation initiatives. We offer a stimulating work environment, competitive compensation package, and opportunities for professional growth. Apply now and help shape the future of Hexagon’s technology solutions.

title: Service Now Engineer - Hybrid Madrid
description:
We are looking for the very Top Talent…and we would be delighted if you were to join our team!

More in details, UST is a multinational company based in North America, certified as a Top Employer and Great Place to Work company with over 35.000 employees all over the world and presence in more than 35 countries. We are leaders on digital technology services, and we provide large-scale technologic solutions to big companies.


What we look for?

We are looking for Senior ServiceNow Engineer , to contribute in a project with one of our global customer in wealth management. We are building a very strong team comprised of high caliber professionals that will work closely with the client’s IT and Business stakeholders to deliver impactful programs.

You will have the opportunity to work on challenging projects with talented colleagues in an international environment while developing your domain knowledge working for a top company.

What do we expect from you?

  • Understanding of ITIL v3/v4 frameworks and their practical application within ServiceNow.

title: Gerente de Projetos - Saneamento
description:
QUADRANTE – Grupo internacional de engenharia, com forte atuação em Energia, Mobilidade e Cidades Sustentáveis, e presença crescente em projetos financiados por instituições financeiras internacionais.


Buscamos um Gerente de Projetos experiente e estratégico para liderar a gestão de projetos de saneamento. O profissional ideal terá um profundo conhecimento técnico em projetos de saneamento, incluindo sistemas de abastecimento de água, esgotamento sanitário, redes, adutoras e coletores, associadas a Quadrante junto aos nossos clientes em todas as fases do projeto.

Esta posição é fundamental para orquestrar as entregas, garantir a comunicação eficaz com o cliente e assegurar que os projetos avancem em alinhamento com os padrões de excelência da Quadrante, em estreita colaboração com as equipes técnicas e a diretoria de operações.


Responsabilidades:


• Liderar o planejamento, execução, monitoramento e encerramento dos projetos de saneamento (abastecimento de água, esgotamento sanitário, ETEs, ETAs, redes, adutoras e obras associadas), assegurando alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa e com os requisitos contratuais.

• Atuar como principal ponto focal técnico e gerencial perante o cliente, mantendo comunicação clara, tempestiva e estruturada em todas as fases do projeto, fortalecendo relações de confiança e garantindo o correto entendimento das necessidades e expectativas.

• Gerenciar integralmente o escopo, cronograma, orçamento, qualidade, riscos e recursos dos projetos, aplicando metodologias consolidadas de gerenciamento (PMI, PMBOK, Agile adaptado a engenharia, ou similares), garantindo entregas dentro dos padrões acordados.

• Coordenar o desenvolvimento técnico junto a equipes multidisciplinares (engenharia sanitária, hidráulica, ambiental, civil, geotecnia, topografia, BIM, orçamento e planejamento), garantindo integração entre disciplinas e consistência técnica entre os produtos entregues.

• Acompanhar a evolução física e financeira dos projetos, realizando reuniões periódicas de alinhamento com líderes de equipe, identificando desvios, implementando ações corretivas e comunicando riscos antecipadamente ao cliente e à direção interna.

• Gerenciar o contrato de forma estratégica: acompanhar termos, escopo contratado, aditivos, medição de serviços, fluxo de entregáveis, negociação de pleitos e suporte direto às áreas jurídica, financeira e de operações quanto a compliance e obrigações contratuais.

• Assegurar a qualidade dos projetos entregues por atenderem os desempenhos operacionais e econômicos requeridos pelas boas práticas e pelas Normas Técnicas brasileiras produzidas pela ABNT ou na falta delas normas ASTM ou ISO e diretrizes das Concessionárias, as normas ambientais e de segurança aplicáveis.

• Elaborar relatórios gerenciais, dashboards e apresentações executivas para direção e clientes, consolidando status de projeto, risco, indicadores de desempenho, decisões pendentes e planos de ação.

• Mapear oportunidades de melhoria contínua, propondo soluções técnicas, otimizações de processo, inovações e uso de tecnologias (BIM, SIG, modelagem hidráulica, automação de processos) para aumentar eficiência e agregar valor ao cliente.

• Representar tecnicamente a empresa em reuniões, workshops e visitas a campo, garantindo visão integrada das condições reais do sistema e alinhamento entre projeto, execução e necessidades operacionais.

• Promover um ambiente colaborativo, orientando equipes, fomentando boas práticas de gestão e assegurando comunicação fluida entre todas as disciplinas e partes envolvidas.

Formação & Qualificações

• Graduação em Engenharia Civil, Engenharia Ambiental, Engenharia Sanitária ou áreas correlatas.

• Registro profissional ativo (CREA).

• Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos, Saneamento, Infraestrutura ou Gestão Empresarial (desejável).

• Certificações como PMP, CAPM, Prince2, Scrum Master ou similares são diferenciais valorizados em gerenciamento de projetos de engenharia.


Experiência Profissional:


• Experiência comprovada na coordenação ou gerenciamento de projetos de saneamento, incluindo:

– sistemas de abastecimento de água

– esgotamento sanitário

– redes, adutoras e coletores

– ETEs, ETAs, elevatórias

– obras de infraestrutura associadas


• Vivência em empresas de engenharia, consultoria, concessionárias de água/esgoto ou projetos públicos.

• Experiência na liderança de equipes multidisciplinares (hidráulica, civil, ambiental, geotecnia, BIM etc.).

• Histórico na gestão completa do ciclo de vida de projetos: planejamento, execução, monitoramento, controle e encerramento.

• Experiência em análise de contratos, aditivos, pleitos, medição e interface com clientes públicos e privados.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:

• Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos:

– MS Project

– Pacote Office (Excel avançado)

– ferramentas de controle de indicadores (Power BI é diferencial)


• Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas técnicas:

– AutoCAD

– Civil3D

– softwares de modelagem hidráulica (EPANET, SEWERGEMS, WaterGEMS)

– BIM (Revit, Navisworks, ou familiaridade com metodologia)


• Conhecimento atualizado sobre:

– normas ABNT/NBR aplicáveis ao saneamento

– diretrizes técnicas de concessionárias (Sabesp, Copasa, Sanepar, BRK, Aegea etc.)

– legislações ambientais e regulatórias

– requisitos de licenciamento ambiental (LP, LI, LO)


Competências Comportamentais:

• Forte capacidade de liderança e gestão de pessoas.

• Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, com habilidade para representar a empresa frente a clientes e órgãos públicos.

• Capacidade de negociação, organização e visão crítica.

• Alta capacidade analítica para tomada de decisão.

• Perfil proativo, resiliente e orientado a resultados.

• Habilidade em gerir múltiplos projetos simultaneamente, com calma e eficiência.


Idiomas

The opportunity to develop yourself and be part of a fast-growing global company.

Remuneration commensurate with experience.

title: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician

Location: Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required

Reports to: Account Manager and CTO

Contract Type: CLT


About LG Sonic: LG Sonic is a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations.


Position Summary:

The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.

Position duties and responsibilities:

  • Assemble and install LG Sonic equipment at client locations throughout Brazil, ensuring proper setup and functionality.
  • Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance.
  • Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support.
  • Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms.
  • Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively.
  • Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups.
  • Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations.
  • Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities.


Qualification and requirements:

  • Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) for client interactions, technical support, and reporting.
  • Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments.
  • Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus.


Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued.


LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.


Application Process: If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps:

  • Submit Your CV: Please send your updated CV in English to with the subject line: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician .
  • Apply via Recruitment Platforms: You may also apply through recruitment websites where this position is posted. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English .
  • Application Review: Our HR team will carefully review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps.
  • Interview Process: Selected candidates will be invited for interviews to assess their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

We are seeking a strategic and technically strong Data Scientist to support high-impact analytical initiatives across finance, strategy, pricing, and commercial functions. This role works directly with the Head of Strategy, and senior commercial leaders to shape business decisions through rigorous analytics, AI-driven insights, and a deep understanding of complex product and channel environments. The ideal candidate brings a blend of technical excellence, business acumen, and the ability to influence outcomes across a diverse set of stakeholders.

What you'll do

Strategic Partnership & Collaboration

  • Serve as a core analytical partner to the CFO, Head of Strategy, and commercial leadership, helping define analytical priorities and shaping strategic decision-making.
  • Translate evolving business needs into robust analytical plans, ensuring clarity around objectives, data requirements, and expected impact.

Advanced Analytics & Data Science Execution

  • Develop predictive models, segmentation frameworks and optimization analyses to support financial planning, portfolio strategy, and commercial performance.
  • Build and refine scalable analytics workflows in SQL and Google BigQuery, ensuring high-quality data pipelines and efficient processing of large datasets.
  • Apply AI and machine learning techniques to automate processes, enhance decision-making, and unlock new insights across pricing, customer behavior, and product performance.

Revenue, Pricing & Growth Insights

  • Conduct deep-dive analyses into revenue drivers, product mix, elasticity, promotions, and customer/segment profitability.
  • Support revenue management or growth initiatives by identifying leverage points for price optimization, margin enhancement, sales acceleration, and product strategy.
  • Evaluate performance across complex or configurable product portfolios, ensuring insights account for multivariate product and commercial structures.

Business Communication & Influence

  • Synthesize analytical findings into clear, concise narratives tailored for executives and commercial teams.
  • Help build a data-driven culture by elevating analytical standards, sharing best practices, and improving access to insights.


Who you are

  • 5+ years in data science, advanced analytics, revenue management, pricing analytics, or growth-focused analytical roles.
  • Deep expertise in SQL and Google BigQuery, with hands-on experience managing large, complex datasets.
  • Proven track record partnering with finance leaders, strategy leaders, or senior commercial executives.
  • Strong business judgment with the ability to proactively identify high-value analytics and AI opportunities.
  • Experience with complex product portfolios, configurable/custom products, or multi-category commercial environments.
  • Hands-on experience implementing AI-driven methods within data science workflows.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to align technical insights to business priorities.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing (Required)
  • Previous experience supporting teams globally with a focus on North America (Preferred)
  • Experience with pricing analytics, elasticity modeling, promotional analysis, or revenue optimization. (Preferred)
  • Prior work in growth, revenue strategy, commercial analytics, or similar functions. (Preferred)
  • Proficiency in Python, R, or comparable languages for advanced modeling. (Preferred)

What's in it for you

  • Annual base salary range: BRL 235,000 - 319,000
  • Bonus target range: 25%
  • Enjoy our Flexible Time Off (FTO) program designed to support work–life balance (excludes new hires in Illinois).
  • Generous benefits package
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development and professional growth

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate’s education, experience, skills and potential.
Hunter Douglas is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

description:
Sobre a empresa:

A COFCO International é uma empresa global de agronegócios que compra, armazena, vende, processa e distribui commodities agrícolas essenciais: grãos, oleaginosas, açúcar, algodão e café.

Com sede em Genebra, na Suíça, a COFCO International emprega cerca de 11 mil profissionais, em 37 países, e possui ativos em todos os continentes, com negociações em mais de 50 países.

A COFCO International é uma plataforma de agronegócios da COFCO Corporation, uma das maiores companhias agrícolas e de alimentos da China, com atuação global.


Sobre a vaga:

Responsável por garantir a aquisição de todas as demandas de compras de equipamentos e serviços industriais.


Principais responsabilidades:

• Negociar termos e condições contratuais favoráveis com fornecedores selecionados, visando obter os melhores preços, condições de pagamento e cláusulas de garantia;

• Preparar e emitir pedidos de compra conforme necessário, garantindo a precisão das informações, a conformidade com os requisitos internos e a documentação adequada para registro e rastreabilidade;

• Acompanhar o status dos pedidos de compra, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos de entrega, resolvendo problemas de logística e coordenando com os departamentos internos para garantir a recepção adequada dos produtos ou serviços adquiridos;

Requisitos:

• Superior Completo em Administração, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas;

• Experiência na área de compras de equipamentos e serviços industriais;

• Excel Avançado;

• Sistema ERP – SAP (Desejável);

• Habilidade em negociação.


A COFCO International é uma empresa que promove a igualdade de oportunidades.   • Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a strong advantage ).
  • Willingness to travel across LATAM .

title: Organizational Culture Specialist
description:
About the Company

About Us: Keeta is an independent brand under Meituan, which is the world's largest technology-driven retail enterprise. We focus on food and consumer goods delivery services in the international market. Our mission is: "Help people eat better and live better."



About the Role

The role involves leading the development and implementation of our corporate culture strategy, ensuring alignment with our business goals and enhancing employee engagement.



Responsibilities

Culture Strategy & Implementation

  • Culture Framework Development: Lead the development and iteration of the corporate culture system, ensuring strong alignment with company strategy, values, and business goals.
  • Culture Activation Programs: Design and implement culture activation plans (e.g., translating values into observable behaviors, culture training, internal communications) to drive company-wide understanding and practice.
  • Culture Diagnosis & Improvement: Assess the current culture through surveys, interviews, and data analysis; provide improvement recommendations and drive execution.

Culture Branding & Employer Branding

  • Culture Campaigns & Events: Plan and execute culture initiatives (e.g., Values Day, Culture Week, executive dialogues) to strengthen employee belonging and engagement.
  • Employer Brand Integration: Partner with HR and PR teams to embed corporate culture into employer branding efforts (e.g., recruiting, social media, ESG reports).
  • Internal Culture Platforms: Manage internal culture platforms (e.g., internal newsletters/magazines, culture walls, digital communities) to ensure content quality and communication effectiveness.

Leadership Development & Culture Enablement

  • Leadership Culture Training: Provide cultural leadership training for managers and help them become culture ambassadors.
  • Cross-functional Culture Projects: Drive cross-department culture programs (e.g., innovation culture, collaboration culture) to address business pain points.

Globalization & Localization

  • Cross-cultural Alignment: Navigate cultural differences to ensure global consistency while respecting local characteristics.

Qualifications

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree or above; 5+ years of experience in culture-related fields (e.g., corporate culture, cross-cultural management). International/multinational experience and strong insights into multicultural contexts are preferred.
  • Language Skills: English as a working language; able to communicate efficiently in English, collaborate in meetings, and produce written documents.
  • Creative Thinking: Highly creative and idea-driven, with strong execution ability to turn ideas into tangible outcomes.


Required Skills

  • Strong understanding of corporate culture and employee engagement strategies.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to analyze data and provide actionable insights.


Preferred Skills

  • Experience in managing culture-related projects in a multinational environment.
  • Hands-on experience in end-to-end event planning and execution, with proven ability to build programs from scratch


Pay range and compensation package

Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.



Equal Opportunity Statement

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals.

title: Analista de Planejamento (Foco em medição)
description:
A Tractebel é uma multinacional referência global em engenharia consultiva com mais de 160 anos de história, e faz parte do Grupo ENGIE , líder mundial em transição energética. Além de fornecermos soluções integradas nas áreas de infraestrutura, energia, meio ambiente e recursos hídricos, atuamos também na administração e no gerenciamento de obras desses setores, contribuindo para a missão do Grupo de tornar o mundo mais resiliente, habitável, energizado e sustentável.


Aqui, você participa de projetos de grande impacto , aprende com especialistas renomados e desenvolve sua carreira em um ambiente colaborativo e multidisciplinar, contribuindo diretamente para a melhoria da qualidade de vida de milhões de pessoas .


Cada projeto é uma oportunidade de deixar um legado de engenharia do qual nos orgulhamos — e buscamos talentos que queiram fazer parte dessa transformação como Analista de Planejamento (Foco em Medição).


ATRIBUIÇÕES DO CARGO:


  • Conduzir o processo de medição através da análise e conferência das documentações que atestam a realização do serviço;
  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir os critérios de medição estabelecidos nos contratos;
  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir os prazos estabelecidos para análise e pagamento das medições;
  • Conduzir reuniões de esclarecimentos do processo de medição com os prepostos das contratadas.
  • Organizar e manter organizada as documentações originárias dos fornecedores;
  • Manter a rastreabilidade das evidências para fins de auditoria;
  • Manter alinhamento diário do processo de medição com a área da implantação;
  • Elaborar planos de ação para atendimento dos desvios encontrados nas auditorias;
  • Propor melhorias para o processo de medição;
  • Leitura e interpretação de projetos para elaboração de takeoff e curvas de desembolso financeiro de contratos.
  • Elaboração de correspondências para subcontratados.


COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS:


  • Graduação completa em Engenharias;
  • Experiência em obras de grande porte com escopo de civil, montagem mecânica e elétrica;
  • Vivência com leitura e interpretação de projetos de elétrica, mecânica e civil.


OUTRAS INFORMAÇÕES:

  • Todas as nossas vagas estão disponíveis, também, para candidatos com deficiência ou beneficiários reabilitados pelo INSS;
  • Local de trabalho: Belo Horizonte/MG.

title: Especialista de Governanca de dados
description:
Faça parte de uma das maiores empresas de serviços de TI do mundo! Aqui você transforma a sua carreira!


Por que entrar na TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, é por isso que vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado, cheia de oportunidades de melhoria, e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para o nosso sucesso em um ambiente colaborativo.


Estamos procurando por Especialista de Governanca de dados , que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira, em modalidade CLT , Presencia em Londrina - PR.


Nessa posicao voce irá:

O profissional Especialista de Governança de Dados será responsável por desenvolver, implementar e sustentar a estratégia de governança de dados da organização. Atuando na implantação do modelo de Data Stewards, liderando engajamento, capacitação e construção de indicadores de qualidade. Também será peça-chave em iniciativas de letramento em dados e no avanço da maturidade dos dados organizacionais, garantindo que os dados se tornem um ativo estratégico para o negócio. Sua missão é garantir que os ativos de dados sejam gerenciados de forma segura, consistente e em conformidade com as políticas internas e regulamentações externas, como a LGPD. Este papel é fundamental para transformar dados em um ativo estratégico confiável, suportando a tomada de decisões e a eficiência operacional em larga escala.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento de Estruturas (Frameworks): Projetar e implementar o framework de governança de dados, incluindo políticas, padrões, processos e diretrizes.
  • Gestão de Dados Mestres (MDM): Liderar ou participar ativamente de iniciativas de MDM para garantir uma fonte única e confiável para os dados críticos da empresa (clientes, produtos, fornecedores).
  • Qualidade de Dados: Definir métricas de qualidade de dados (Data Quality), estabelecer processos de monitoramento e liderar projetos para correção e melhoria contínua dos dados.
  • Catálogo e Dicionário de Dados: Estruturar e manter o catálogo de dados corporativo, garantindo que a linhagem de dados, metadados de negócio e definições sejam claras e acessíveis.
  • Papeis e Responsabilidades: Colaborar com as áreas de negócio para definir e formalizar os papéis de Data Owners e Data Stewards, fornecendo treinamento e suporte.
  • Capacitação e Letramento em Dados: Conduzir programas de capacitação, promovendo a cultura data-driven e elevando a maturidade de dados da organização.
  • Modelo de Data Stewards: Estruturar, implementar e acompanhar o modelo de Data Stewards, promovendo engajamento, capacitação e responsabilidade nas áreas de negócio.
  • Maturidade de Dados: Avaliar o nível de maturidade organizacional em dados, definir roadmaps de evolução e acompanhar a execução, garantindo que os dados sejam ativos estratégicos.
  • Conformidade e Segurança: Assegurar que as práticas de gestão de dados estejam em conformidade com a LGPD e outras regulamentações, trabalhando em conjunto com as equipes de Segurança da Informação e Jurídico.
  • Liderança e Influência: Atuar como uma autoridade no tema, orientando equipes de projeto, arquitetos e líderes de negócio sobre as melhores práticas de governança.

Diferenciais (Nice to Have):

● Experiência no setor de atuação da empresa (ex: Financeiro, Varejo, Mineração).

● Conhecimento em ferramentas de governança em nuvem (ex: Azure Purview, GCP DataPlex, AWS Glue).

● Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) aplicadas a projetos de dados.

● Inglês avançado ou fluente.


Formação e Experiência Mínima

Superior completo e comprovado em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Obrigatório: Pelo menos uma pós-graduação, MBA ou certificação avançada na área (ex: DAMA CDMP Practitioner/Master, CIMP). Certificações de nível fundamental (Associate) não cumprem este requisito.


Experiência Profissional:

Mínimo de 9 anos de experiência de mercado, com um histórico comprovado na proposição de estratégia e implementação de programas de governança de dados em empresas de grande porte.

Estabilidade Profissional:

Estabilidade média de 3 anos nos últimos empregos registrados no histórico curricular.


Competências Técnicas (Hard Skills)

  • Domínio completo de todas as competências do nível Sênior.
  • Experiência comprovada na criação de business cases e na definição de ROI para iniciativas de governança.
  • Profundo conhecimento em arquiteturas de dados modernas e como a governança se aplica em ambientes Cloud e Big Data.
  • Liderança na implementação e gerenciamento de plataformas de MDM (multidomínio é um diferencial).
  • Capacidade de definir a estratégia de governança de ponta a ponta, alinhada aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.


Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills):

  • Comunicação Executiva: Habilidade para apresentar e defender a estratégia de governança para diretores e C-level.
  • Visão Estratégica: Capacidade de pensar a longo prazo e antecipar desafios e oportunidades em governança de dados.
  • Liderança e Mentoria: Influenciar pelo conhecimento, atuando como mentor para analistas e outros especialistas da equipe.
  • Negociação e Influência: Habilidade para construir consenso entre áreas com interesses divergentes e garantir o buy-in para as iniciativas de governança.


Certificações desejaveis

  • CPDG – Certificado Profissional em Governança de Dados
  • CGQD – Certificação em Governança e Qualidade de Dados
  • CAGD – Certificação Avançada em Governança de Dados
  • Data Governance Fundamentals – DataCamp
  • CDMP – Certified Data Management Professional (DAMA International)
  • CIPP/E – Certified Information Privacy Professional/Europe (IAPP)
  • Certificações AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud em Data Management

title: Supervisor de Enfermagem - Unidade de Internação Pediátrica Oncológica
description:
Requisitos:

-COREN ativo e dentro da validade;

-Necessário boa vivência com gestão de equipes, experiência na área assistencial, com oncologia pediátrica.




Atividades:


- Tomar ciência, diariamente, das orientações constantes do livro de Ordens e Ocorrências e demais anotações, a fim de tomar ciência das intercorrências ocorridas no plantão diurno possibilitando dar continuidade aos tratamentos dos pacientes;


- Com base na escala mensal de funcionários, recebida da Gerência de Enfermagem, conferir diariamente a presença, atrasos, licença médicas e trocas de plantão realizado pelos funcionários, anotando no livro de ordens e ocorrência as divergências encontradas;


- Inspecionar, diariamente, os Setores de Enfermagem da Unidade, avaliando a qualidade de assistência prestada e identificando a necessidade de utilização de equipamentos e remanejamento de pessoal para prestação de atendimento adequado, bem como se as equipes estão utilizando o uniforme padrão da Unidade, com seus respectivos equipamentos de segurança;


- Orientar as atividades desenvolvidas pelos Enfermeiros Plantonistas, na realização de suas atividades diárias, bem como observando e orientando aspectos de desvio de comportamentos, a fim de corrigir os problemas com colaboradores no seu turno;


- Atender os clientes e seus acompanhantes, quando solicitado, esclarecendo as dúvidas apresentadas, bem como providenciando a solução aos superiores de plantão, caso o assunto fuja dos limites de sua autonomia;


- Garantir o cumprimento das Instruções Operacionais Técnicas e Administrativas do serviço noturno como: preparo pré-operatório, pré-exames, transferência de pacientes, conferência de material/medicação, requisição de farmácia, registrando as intercorrências e dificuldades encontradas no plantão no livro de Ordens e Ocorrências;


- Apoiar a Recepção de Internação propondo e encaminhando soluções inerentes a liberação de quarto ou leito, a fim de facilitar o processo de internação de novos ou transferências internas de pacientes;


- Acionar, quando necessário, o Setor de Engenharia Clínica, visando providenciar o reparo de equipamentos defeituosos na Unidade, durante seu plantão;


- Acompanhar e orientar situações de acidentes de trabalho ocorridos no seu turno, encaminhando os acidentados ao Setor de Emergência, bem como comunicando ao Setor de Medicina e Segurança do Trabalho as ocorrências;


- Intermediar situações que necessitem de auxílio a outras Unidades da Rede, obtendo autorização superior para os casos de: empréstimo de materiais e equipamentos médico-hospitalares, uso de autoclave e etc;


- Participar da elaboração de manuais de rotinas ou POPs, junto com as áreas de CCIH, Qualidade e Educação Continuada, a fim de contribuir para a implantação de processo de melhores práticas de assistência hospitalar;


- Testar materiais e equipamentos novos e responder pareceres técnicos enviados pelos setores de padronização e engenharia clínica respectivamente para análise e decisão sobre a utilização/aquisição.

title: Business Analytics Manager Logistics Optimization
description:
Let’s talk about Keeta

Keeta is the international arm of Meituan, one of the world’s largest delivery platforms. Our mission is bold: to revolutionize the delivery of food and everyday products across the globe. Our motto says it all: “We help people eat better, live better.”

With our Brazil launch approaching, we are expanding quickly and building a world-class team from the ground up. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy solving complex operational challenges, and want to make a visible impact, this could be the right opportunity for you.


About the Role

We are looking for a Business Analytics Manager Logistics Optimization to support the design and continuous improvement of Keeta’s delivery dispatch system. In this role, you will analyze operational performance, identify opportunities to improve courier allocation and routing efficiency, and translate data insights into operational improvements while working closely with product, engineering, and operations teams.


What You’ll Do ⭐

  • Monitor and analyze dispatch performance metrics to identify operational inefficiencies and optimization opportunities
  • Support the design and improvement of courier allocation logic, routing structures, and delivery execution frameworks
  • Develop analytical models and dashboards to evaluate delivery efficiency, ETA performance, and courier utilization
  • Identify potential gaps in dispatch algorithms and provide structured insights to support system improvements
  • Translate operational data and performance trends into actionable recommendations for logistics strategy
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and operations teams to implement and validate optimization initiatives
  • Support experimentation cycles to test new operational parameters and measure performance impact


What We’re Looking For ✅

  • Experience in marketplace platforms, logistics operations, ride-hailing, delivery services, or e-commerce environments
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using data to diagnose operational challenges and drive improvements
  • Proficiency with analytical tools such as SQL, Python, or BI platforms (Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
  • Ability to translate complex data into clear business insights and operational recommendations
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, and operations
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken


Why Join Us

  • Be part of building and scaling a new global delivery platform from the ground up
  • Work in a dynamic environment where analytical insights directly influence operational performance
  • Collaborate with talented teams across product, engineering, and operations
  • Join a culture that values ownership, innovation, and continuous learning


Ready to jump in?

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Coordenador(a) de turno - Molduras
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

To lead a group of 2-3 Sales Associates in their day-to-day sales activity. To drive revenue growth through managing your team with their opportunity portfolio, personal marketing activity & personal development. Your role will be compounded by owning your own opportunity portfolio as well; supporting clients in assessing their Human Capital Management strategy & demonstrating why ADP should be their chosen partner.

title: Technical Account Manager, Hybrid São Paulo
description:
About Us:


HBX Group is a leading B2B ecosystem player in the TravelTech space, connecting and empowering businesses in the ever-evolving world of travel. We drive growth for our clients and partners while removing friction from the end-to-end travel experience. Our cloud-based technology platforms offer fast and reliable access to a unique portfolio of travel products & services, while rich data and intelligence seamlessly connect supply and demand worldwide.


We have over more than 3,000 experts worldwide, including specialists on the ground who provide insights and support to boost trading even further, especially in the most hard-to-reach segments. This unique blend of technology, data and passionate people serves as a catalyst for all businesses aiming to unlock their full potential in the travel arena.


HBX Group comprises four best-in-class B2B brands that meet the needs of its growing and diverse client base across 190+ global markets:


• Hotelbeds, who cater for the specific needs of hoteliers, tour operators, airlines and online travel agents


• Bedsonline, exclusively serving the retail travel segment


• Roiback, the HotelTech partner for independent hotels and chains seeking growth through direct channel solutions


• TravelStack, providing all products, services and solutions to businesses looking to enter into the lucrative travel arena.


Job Summary


We are looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) with a strong technology foundation and a proven ability to deliver strategic solutions for enterprise clients. This role combines technical expertise with customer-centric account management , ensuring seamless integration, optimization, and long-term success for our most strategic partners.

As a TAM, you will act as a trusted advisor , building strong relationships with key accounts, driving technical excellence, and collaborating across global teams. You will lead technical engagements, oversee API client optimization, and provide proactive solutions that align with business objectives. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and is passionate about solving complex technical challenges.


Job Responsibilities


Territory Growth & Development

  • Partner with sales teams to position and deliver technical solutions to strategic customers through presentations, demos, evaluations, and technical objection handling.
  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for key accounts, ensuring smooth communication and integration.
  • Maximize product adoption and distribution from a technical perspective .

Solution Delivery & Optimization

  • Lead all technical activities related to customer onboarding and API integrations.
  • Provide post-sales technical support , troubleshoot issues, and resolve complex cases.
  • Analyze client performance and define optimization strategies to drive efficiency and scalability.
  • Develop scripts and automation tools to monitor, alert, and report on production environments.

Collaboration & Governance

  • Work closely with internal teams and external partners to align technical requirements with business goals.
  • Participate in global and regional projects , ensuring timely delivery and accurate reporting.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation and ensure KPIs are consistently met.

Required Skills & Experience


  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering , or related field.
  • Proven experience as a Strategic Technical Account Manager or similar role.
  • Strong knowledge of REST APIs, XML, JSON , and related technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with Databases & SQL .
  • Understanding of automation practices across development, build, and deployment phases.
  • Familiarity with build management and CI/CD tools .
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to produce clear, maintainable documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills , initiative, and ability to work in fast-paced environments.
  • Experience in the Travel Industry is a plus.
  • ADVANCED ENGLISH is a must

At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.


You will have the opportunity to work for a company that is going through significant change in becoming the world´s leading travel services provider. We are looking for people that are ready to ride the wave in this exciting journey.

title: Supervisor de Implantação
description:
A Convergint é uma empresa global, fundada em 2001 nos arredores de Chicago, que atua como integradora de sistemas especializada em segurança eletrônica, automação predial, áudio e vídeo, sistemas de incêndio e life safety, com o objetivo de ser o melhor provedor de serviços para os nossos clientes.   • Atuar na leitura de diagramas, levantamento de materiais, testes e ajustes dos sistemas instalados, bem como no preenchimento de relatórios e documentação de campo;
  • Realizar o levantamento de informações em campo para realização de AS-BUILT e DATA BOOK dos trabalhos executados.

  • Formação Técnica em Eletrônica, Eletrotécnica ou Graduação em Engenharia;
  • Vivência em montagem de racks, fixação e instalação de equipamentos, além de conectorização (P2, P10, XLR, RCA, HDMI, RJ45 etc.) e interligação entre dispositivos de diferentes marcas;
  • Vivência com equipamentos e sistemas AMX, Biamp,Crestron, QSC, Shure, Absen, LG e outros;

title: Global HRBP
description:
About JD's International Business

We are committed to building a digitally intelligent cross-border supply chain and global retail infrastructure. Leveraging our global supply chain capabilities, JD continues to expand in markets where we possess distinct competitive advantages. Our diversified businesses—including retail, logistics, technology, industrial development, manufacturing, and healthcare—are growing in synergy. Currently, JD operates worldwide, with a presence in countries and regions such as China, the United States, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, France, Germany, Spain, Brazil, Hungary, Japan, South Korea, Australia, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE, serving customers across the globe.


Position Mission

As a core HR partner for our international expansion, you will be at the forefront of our rapidly growing global business. This is not just an HR role—it is a mission to become a "Growth Engine" and "Organizational Architect" for the business. We invest in your future through a unique 6-to-12-month immersive rotation program at our Beijing Headquarters. This program is designed to provide an in-depth understanding of our core business, culture, and operations, empowering you to drive organizational capability, build world-class teams, and ensure our people strategy accelerates our global growth.


Core Responsibilities

1. Global Talent Program: Beijing Headquarters Rotation (6–12 Months)

- Immerse yourself in the core operations, culture, and leadership network of our global business.

- Participate in structured training and mentorship while contributing to key projects in talent acquisition, organizational development, and HR analytics.

- Build a solid foundation and holistic perspective before transitioning to support international business teams.


2. Strategic HR Partnership & Business Insight

- Translate business strategies in international markets (e.g., Southeast Asia, Europe, North America, Middle East) into actionable people strategies.

- Provide forward-looking insights on organizational design, talent density, and cultural integration.


3. Talent Engine & Pipeline Development

- Lead end-to-end recruitment for critical roles in supply chain, warehouse management, cross-border logistics, and localized operations.

- Design and implement talent development initiatives such as the "Global Young Talent Program" to build a robust pipeline of future leaders.


4. Organizational Effectiveness & Team Activation

- Diagnose and optimize organizational structures and processes to enhance collaboration and performance in cross-cultural settings.

- Drive a results-oriented performance management system and leverage HR data to support business decision-making.


5. Global Culture & Employee Experience

- Champion JD’s corporate culture and foster an open, agile, and inclusive team environment across regions.

- Proactively manage employee relations and enhance the end-to-end employee lifecycle experience.


Qualifications & Attributes

We are seeking a future leader with business acumen, an entrepreneurial mindset, and high growth potential—not just a traditional HR practitioner.


Must-Haves

- Bachelor’s degree or above with at least 5 years of HR experience. Experience in internet, e-commerce, retail, logistics, or consulting is preferred.

- Global mindset: Overseas study/work experience or prior exposure to supporting international business is highly advantageous.

- Business acumen: Strong interest and ability to quickly grasp business logic, profitability models, and core challenges.

- Superior cognitive and problem-solving skills:

- Structured thinking: Ability to dissect complex situations and develop clear solution frameworks.

- Data-driven: Skilled in using data analysis to identify issues, validate hypotheses, and drive decisions.

- Drive & resilience:

- Ownership: Takes full responsibility for business challenges and outcomes.

- Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and views challenges as growth opportunities.


Core Competencies

- Excellent communication and influencing skills across all levels and cultures.

- A keen eye for identifying and developing high-potential talent.

- Collaborative team player.


What We Offer

- A 6-to-12-month foundational rotation at Beijing Headquarters, connecting you with the core of our business and setting the stage for long-term success.

- A platform at the forefront of international growth, where your contributions directly impact our core strategy.

- Accelerated career growth by solving complex, real-world business challenges from day one.

- An environment of trust and autonomy that encourages bold thinking and innovation.

title: Motion Graphics Video Editor

The channel explores topics such as archaeology, religion, pseudoscience, cults, history, and misinformation. Our goal is to create engaging educational content that encourages curiosity and critical thinking .


Role Description

Holy Koolaid Media is looking for a highly skilled video editor with strong motion graphics experience to help produce fast-paced documentary and explainer videos for YouTube. Our content explores history, archaeology, science, and critical thinking , often examining religion, pseudoscience, and misinformation through a skeptical lens. We are looking for someone who can turn research-heavy scripts into compelling visual stories using animation, motion graphics, archival footage, and creative editing. This role requires someone who is detail-oriented, intellectually curious, and comfortable working with complex historical and scientific material . The position is fully remote , with occasional meetings in São Paulo preferred but not required .


What You'll Do

  • Edit long-form YouTube documentary and explainer videos
  • Create motion graphics and animations that help explain complex ideas
  • Cut footage to match script timing and narration
  • Add B-roll, archival footage, and visual references
  • Design and animate titles, diagrams, maps, and visual explanations
  • Add sound effects and polish audio
  • Work closely with the creator to ensure the visuals enhance the storytelling
  • Help research and locate visual assets relevant to historical and scientific topics
  • Maintain strong attention to detail to ensure accuracy and clarity


Required Skills

  • Strong experience with Adobe Premiere Pro (this is essential)
  • Experience with Photoshop
  • Experience creating motion graphics or animation
  • Ability to edit according to script timing and narrative pacing
  • Strong visual storytelling instincts
  • Extremely detail-oriented
  • Ability to research and find visual material when needed
  • At least 2 years of experience with motion graphics or animation
  • Ability to work independently and solve problems


Preferred Skills

  • Experience with After Effects
  • Some familiarity with Adobe Audition
  • Experience editing YouTube videos
  • Experience with documentary-style editing
  • Interest in history, archaeology, or science
  • Comfortable working on content that critically examines religion, pseudoscience, and misinformation
  • English proficiency at B1 level or higher (flexible if editing skills are exceptional)


What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate:

  • Thinks like a storyteller, not just an editor
  • Can take complex ideas and make them visually understandable
  • Is comfortable learning new topics quickly
  • Is curious and enjoys researching historical and scientific subjects

How to Apply

Applicants without a portfolio or demo reel will not be considered.

title: Application Engineer
description:
You'll join the AI Products squad to build the next generation of LLM-powered applications for the staffing industry. This is a product engineering role, not a research role. You'll ship real AI products used by real recruiters and real clients.


We're not looking for someone who trains models from scratch. We're looking for someone who knows how to build with LLMs — orchestrating agents, designing RAG pipelines, crafting prompt architectures, and shipping applications that solve real business problems. If you've built a chatbot, an agent, or a RAG app that actually went to production (or close to it), we want to talk.


What You'll Build

Example products in the pipeline

· AI Candidate Matching Engine — Match candidates to job openings using semantic search, skill extraction, and intelligent ranking.

· Intelligent Onboarding Agent — An agentic system that guides new hires through credentialing, document collection, compliance checks, and first-day preparation. Replaces manual follow-up chains.

· Recruiter Copilot — An AI assistant embedded in recruiters' daily workflow. Surfaces candidate suggestions, drafts outreach, summarizes conversations, and flags placement risks.

· Conversational BI — Natural language interface to business data. Users ask questions in plain English, get charts, tables, and insights back.

What You'll Do

· Design and build agentic systems — multi-step AI workflows that reason, retrieve, and act across multiple tools and data sources

· Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines — connect LLMs to company data through vector databases, semantic search, and context injection

· Craft prompt architectures — design system prompts, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought patterns, and guardrails for production LLM applications

· Integrate with APIs and data sources — consume data from our CDI platform (Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse), ATS (JobDiva), VMS platforms, and internal systems

· Ship production-grade applications — not prototypes. Build with error handling, monitoring, logging, fallback strategies, and user-facing quality

· Collaborate with the Data Platform squad — define what data you need in what format, and work with data engineers to make AI-ready datasets available

· Evaluate and iterate on AI quality — build evaluation frameworks, test edge cases, measure accuracy, and improve outputs systematically

· Stay current with the LLM ecosystem — new models, frameworks, and techniques ship weekly. You'll help evaluate what's worth adopting.

What We're Looking For

Must have (1-3 years of experience):

· Shipped at least one LLM-powered application in a real organization (not just personal projects or tutorials). This could be a chatbot, agent, RAG app, content generator, or similar.

· Strong Python skills — you think in Python, not just write it

· Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks — LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar

· Experience building RAG systems — vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS), embedding models, retrieval strategies, context window management

· Understanding of prompt engineering at a production level — not just getting good outputs, but building reliable, consistent, testable prompt architectures

· Familiarity with LLM APIs — OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or open-source model serving (Ollama, vLLM)

· Basic understanding of software engineering practices — Git, API design, error handling, logging

· Good communication in English (daily collaboration with a distributed team)

Nice to have:

· Experience with agent frameworks — multi-agent orchestration, tool use, function calling, planning loops

· Familiarity with fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning) — not required but valuable for future work

· Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs (RAGAS, custom metrics, human-in-the-loop evaluation)

· Knowledge of NLP fundamentals — text classification, NER, semantic similarity, embeddings

· Exposure to cloud deployment — Azure, AWS, or GCP for hosting AI services

· Familiarity with staffing, HR tech, or recruiting industry — understanding placement lifecycles, compliance, credentialing

· Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, or Azure ecosystem


Who You Are

· You graduated recently (1-3 years ago) and have already gotten your hands dirty building real AI applications in a real organization — internship, first job, startup, or contract work

· You're more of a builder than a researcher. You care about shipping products, not publishing papers.

· You're excited by the pace of LLM innovation and naturally stay up to date with new models, frameworks, and techniques

· You're comfortable with ambiguity. Some of these products don't have a playbook — you'll figure it out with the team.

· You're autonomous but collaborative. You can own a product end-to-end but also work closely with data engineers and product stakeholders.

Why This Role

· Build AI products at scale from day one. Our data infrastructure covers millions of candidates, Fortune 500 clients. The problems are real and the impact is immediate.

· Full product ownership. You won't be writing prompt templates in a vacuum. You'll own products end-to-end: architecture, data requirements, prompt design, API integration, quality, and iteration.

· Cutting-edge stack. LLMs, agents, RAG, vector databases, agentic workflows — all in production, not demos.

· Growth trajectory. As the team scales toward an AI Products Squad (2-3 engineers), early joiners will shape the team culture and grow into lead roles.

title: IT Support Specialist
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.


Job Description

The IT Support Specialist provides advanced technical support and contributes to the reliable daily operation of the school’s technology services.

This role assists the Service Desk by resolving escalated technical issues across devices, infrastructure, classroom technology, and academic and institutional systems. The specialist ensures that students, faculty, and staff experience stable, secure, and consistent technology while contributing to documentation, configuration standards, and operational improvements. Working across IT Operations and Systems environments, this role combines strong troubleshooting capability with structured execution and technical discipline to support a dependable and well-managed technology ecosystem.


Service Desk & Tier 2 Support

Provide Tier 2 support for complex technical incidents and requests.

Diagnose and resolve issues related to devices, operating systems, cloud services, authentication, and connectivity.

Escalate infrastructure or systems-level issues appropriately.

Maintain clear documentation of troubleshooting steps and resolutions.

Ensure professional communication and timely follow-up with users.


Device Lifecycle & Endpoint Management

Prepare, configure, enroll, and maintain school-issued devices (MacOS, iOS, Windows).

Apply configuration profiles and policies via device management platforms (MDM).

Troubleshoot device performance, OS issues, application conflicts, and compliance failures.

Coordinate repairs and warranty cases with vendors.

Support printer troubleshooting and print management platform issues.

Update and manage the inventory of technology-related devices.


Infrastructure, AV & Campus Technology

Troubleshoot Wi-Fi connectivity issues, local network problems, and VOIP device incidents.

Support classroom AV systems, projection, audio equipment, and event technology.

Assist with basic network physical-layer tasks (AP swaps, port patching, cabling coordination).

Support firewall filtering and content filtering troubleshooting at user level.


Identity, Access & Systems Configuration

Configure and maintain user accounts, permissions, and role assignments across institutional platforms.

Support setup and configuration of academic and institutional systems

Assist with onboarding and offboarding processes by ensuring correct account provisioning and system access.

Troubleshoot authentication, permissions, and system configuration issues.

Investigate and resolve operational issues related to platform integrations (e.g., user synchronization).

Escalate issues when deeper platform configuration changes, system adjustments, or integration fixes are required.


Documentation & Process Discipline

Maintain technical documentation for recurring procedures and configurations.

Contribute to maintaining system and device standards.

Identify recurring support patterns and recommend practical improvements.

Support implementation of technical projects led by the IT Manager.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent practical experience
  • Intermediate English proficiency (for documentation, vendors, and global teams)
  • 3–5 years in IT support, endpoint management, or systems administration
  • Strong troubleshooting across macOS, iOS, and Windows
  • Apple device management experience (MacBooks, iPads, Apple School Manager)
  • Hands-on with MDM platforms like Microsoft Intune or Mosyle
  • Working knowledge of Google Workspace and Microsoft 365
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) — user lifecycle, permissions, authentication
  • Core networking concepts (TCP/IP, Wi-Fi, VLANs) and connectivity troubleshooting
  • Experience setting up and troubleshooting printers and print management solutions
  • Comfort with classroom AV and presentation technology
  • Organized, able to juggle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Clear communicator with non-technical users; strong service mindset
  • Curious, self-directed learner


Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Analista Sênior de Monitoria de Fornecedores
description:
Criada em 2011, a Zurich Santander Insurance America é uma joint venture entre os grupos Zurich e o Banco Santander, dois dos maiores conglomerados mundiais nos setores de seguros e financeiro. Com uma das maiores carteiras de seguros do mercado, temos sede na Espanha e comercializamos nossos produtos por meio do canal de vendas do Banco Santander no Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai.


Na Zurich Santander, trabalhamos todos os dias para que você seja o protagonista de nossa história e tenha o espaço que merece dentro da nossa empresa. Se você é uma pessoa inovadora, dinâmica, proativa, gosta de desafios e trabalha bem em equipe, este é o seu lugar!


Nosso objetivo é oferecer a você as melhores experiências, queremos que se junte a nós para que juntos possamos construir o futuro da Zurich Santander!


Quais serão suas principais responsabilidades?

• Garantir que o owner do contrato realize a avaliação contínua da qualidade dos serviços contratados, incluindo prazos, custos, nível de serviço e inovação.

• Aplicar, acompanhar e analisar KPIs e SLAs, assegurando aderência aos contratos e identificando oportunidades de melhoria.

• Apoiar reuniões periódicas de alinhamento entre Zurich Santander e fornecedores estratégicos.

• Estruturar e acompanhar planos de ação e programas de melhoria contínua, promovendo evolução de performance.

• Fomentar a capacitação dos fornecedores e o desenvolvimento de parcerias de longo prazo.

• Monitorar a conformidade entre pagamentos e contratos, garantindo aderência às condições acordadas.

• Assegurar a conformidade entre os serviços realizados e os serviços contratados.

• Atuar nos processos de descontinuidade de fornecedores, quando aplicável.

• Apoiar e estruturar a gestão de transição (plano de saída), garantindo continuidade operacional e mitigação de riscos.

• Elaborar relatórios executivos de performance e risco para suporte à tomada de decisão.

• Identificar oportunidades de inovação e eficiência nos serviços prestados.


Quais são os requisitos que procuramos?

• Formação superior completa (Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Direito ou áreas correlatas).

• Experiência prévia em gestão, monitoramento ou desenvolvimento de fornecedores.

• Vivência com gestão de contratos e análise de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs e SLAs).

• Conhecimento em governança de terceiros e gestão de riscos.

• Capacidade analítica e habilidade para trabalhar com dados e relatórios.

• Experiência na condução de reuniões com stakeholders internos e externos.

• Conhecimento em processos de melhoria contínua.

• Domínio em Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Apps.


Para que possa fazer a diferença, é ideal que você tenha as seguintes softskills para esta função:

• Experiência no setor de seguros, bancário ou serviços financeiros.

• Vivência com fornecedores críticos e estratégicos.

• Conhecimento em metodologias de melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma ou similares).

• Experiência em gestão de transição e processos de descontinuidade contratual.

• Perfil com forte capacidade de influência, negociação e gestão de conflitos.

• Forte senso de dono e autonomia.

• Capacidade analítica para suportar tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

• Capacidade de adaptação a mudanças.


Qual é a nossa Proposta de Valor ?

Na Zurich Santander lhe propomos fazer parte de uma organização comprometida com o contexto atual, trabalhando profissionalmente na transformação da indústria bancária/seguradora, oferecendo-lhe crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.


Contamos com um excelente ambiente de trabalho, uma equipa de profissionais diversificada e internacional, incentivamos a mobilidade dentro dos países onde estamos presentes para que possa continuar a crescer como profissional. Além disso, dispomos de um pacote de remuneração e benefícios competitivo e atrativo para os nossos colaboradores.


Junte-se à nossa equipe!

  • Atuar como referência técnica em engenharia de dados Azure, orientando o time em padrões de implementação, troubleshooting e boas práticas;
  • Projetar, desenvolver e sustentar pipelines de dados em Azure Data Factory e Databricks, garantindo execução resiliente, reprocessamento e rastreabilidade;
  • Implementar e evoluir arquitetura Lakehouse com Delta Lake e camadas Bronze, Silver, Gold;
  • Desenvolver transformações em PySpark e SQL, com foco em performance, paralelismo, particionamento e redução de custo;
  • Implementar padrões de qualidade de dados: validações, reconciliação, deduplicação, tratamento de inconsistências e trilha de auditoria;
  • Projetar e implementar integrações com fontes corporativas (bancos relacionais e APIs) e suportar ingestão incremental e CDC quando aplicável;
  • Definir e supervisionar padrões de governança, segurança e compliance em dados, incluindo controle de acesso e conformidade com LGPD;
  • Apoiar o time em revisões técnicas, otimização de performance, gestão de incidentes complexos e análise de causa raiz;
  • Garantir aderência às melhores práticas de engenharia de dados, observabilidade e operação em produção (logs, métricas, alertas e SLAs).

Requisitos :

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados em Azure;
  • Experiência comprovada com Databricks em produção (Jobs/Workflows, clusters, policies, repos e secrets);
  • Domínio de Apache Spark (PySpark) e Python para processamento distribuído;
  • SQL avançado para transformação, otimização e modelagem analítica;
  • Experiência com Delta Lake (MERGE, schema evolution/enforcement, OPTIMIZE/ZORDER, VACUUM e boas práticas de escrita/leitura);
  • Domínio de Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS) e organização de dados por domínio e camadas;
  • Experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, parametrização, integrações e monitoração);
  • Vivência com Git e CI/CD aplicados a pipelines de dados e promoção entre ambientes;
  • Conhecimento sólido em segurança (RBAC, Key Vault, identities) e práticas de auditoria/compliance.

Desejável:

  • Experiência com Unity Catalog (governança, permissões e lineage);
  • Conhecimento em Delta Live Tables e Auto Loader;
  • Experiência com IaC (Terraform, Bicep/ARM);
  • Vivência com observabilidade de pipelines (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, alertas e runbooks);
  • Experiência com Purview (catálogo e governança);
  • Certificações Azure (AZ-900, DP-900, DP-203) e/ou certificações Databricks (Data Engineer Associate/Professional);
  • Experiência em setor regulado (financeiro, seguros) com requisitos fortes de auditoria e compliance.

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;

description:
Cód. 58609


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país.
